channel.description: Notes on academic leadership, AI in higher education, and what helps students finish.

item.title: AI in Higher Education Should Make the Student Experience Better
item.description: The important question isn't simply whether colleges should use AI. It's whether they can use it in ways that make learning clearer, support more students, and help people reach their goals.

item.title: Why I'm writing here
item.description: Twenty years of college leadership leaves you with a long list of lessons. Here is what this blog will cover, and why I am writing it in public.
